title: John Dee's angelic work led to colonizing America as a New Atlantis

tellings.quote: it led directly to the colonization of the United States of America and the new Atlantis.

plain: The English scholar John Dee and his partner Edward Kelley, a medium, are said to have held sessions in which they spoke with angels, and Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official who presents himself as a whistleblower, tells Michels that this work "led directly to the colonization of the United States of America and the new Atlantis." The New Atlantis here means an ideal new society built in a new land. If true, the founding of America would trace back to messages from unseen beings.
